North Street Supplies

Thank you, {{customer.name}}

We have received order {{order.reference}}. A confirmation will be sent to {{customer.email}}. Please keep this receipt until your delivery is complete.

Delivery details

{{customer.address}}

Telephone: {{customer.phone}}. The courier will contact you before delivery.

Delivery is scheduled for {{delivery.date}}. Follow the parcel at the tracking page.

Items

ProductDetails QuantityPrice
USB-C travel charger45 W, two ports1GBP 29.90
Braided charging cable2 m, graphite1GBP 12.50
Laptop standAdjustable aluminium1GBP 34.00
Compact keyboardUK layout, wireless1GBP 59.00
Notebook refillA5, dotted pages1GBP 6.40
Desk organiserOak finish, three trays1GBP 24.90
Insulated bottle500 ml, navy1GBP 18.00
Protective sleeve14 inch, water resistant1GBP 21.00

Delivery: GBP 4.95. VAT is included in the listed prices.

Changes and cancellations

Before dispatch, you can update delivery instructions in your account. Changes to the delivery address may require a new shipping quote. If an item has already left the warehouse, contact support before placing a replacement order.

For returns, keep the original accessories and include the order reference. Refunds are sent to the original payment method after the returned parcel is checked.

Questions? Write to {{support.email}} from {{customer.email}}, or use the contact form in your account. Never send card details by email.

North Street Supplies, 18 Market Road. This is an order confirmation, not a subscription message. Please check your receipt for incorrect quantities.

--message-boundary-42--
